about_the_game:
Sheep Pageant

Welcome to the world of Sheep Pageant, a thrilling and chaotic co-op split-screen farming action game where sheep reign supreme, and the stakes are high! In this fast-paced simulation and management game, you and your friends will compete to breed the most impressive sheep and claim the crown at the prestigious Sheep Pageant.

Oh, and one more thing—aliens are watching.
That’s right. In a delightful twist of intergalactic confusion, a group of aliens—desperate to abduct cows just like in those old Earth myths—have completely misunderstood what cows actually are. Now, convinced that sheep might be the majestic bovines they're after, they’re sponsoring a Sheep Pageant to identify the best "cow" Earth has to offer. Don’t question the logic—just bring your A-game.

->Key Features<-

1. Competitive Sheep Breeding:

Work against the clock to breed the perfect sheep that matches the level’s unique requirements. Select the best parents to produce better offspring and improve your chances of winning. But beware—not all sheep are winners!

2. Vortex Disposal System:

Got a sheep that doesn’t make the cut? Toss it into the swirling water vortex to make room for better candidates. Efficiency is key!

3. Dynamic Farm Management:

Grow and manage crops to feed your sheep and keep them healthy. Plant seeds, water your fields, and use fertilizer to maximize your yield. Sheep poop doubles as fertilizer, so grab your trusty shovel to collect it or clean up rotten crops.

4. Keep Your Sheep Healthy:

Monitor your flock’s health carefully! Sheep can get sick, and if one dies, its skeleton can spread illness to others. Ensure their water buckets are clean and full to keep them hydrated and happy.

5. Dress to Impress:

Once you’ve bred your star sheep, dress it up with a bow and present it for judging at the Sheep Pageant. Will your sheep steal the spotlight—and maybe even get beamed up?

6. Co-op Chaos:
Play solo or team up with friends in split-screen multiplayer. Strategize, manage resources, and outsmart your opponents to win the coveted title of Sheep Champion.

Why You'll Love Sheep Pageant

  • Unique blend of fast-paced simulation, management, and competitive gameplay.

  • Adorable and quirky sheep-themed mechanics.

  • Hilarious moments of chaos as you juggle breeding, farming, and sheep care.

  • A fun and engaging experience for players of all ages.

  • It’s not just about the prize—your sheep might get abducted by aliens who still think “moo” is just a regional sheep dialect.

short_description: Farm life is already chaotic—throw in aliens who think your sheep are cows, and you’ve got Sheep Pageant! Breed your sheep to meet their strange preferences, manage crops, toss out the losers, and compete to impress your clueless cosmic judges in split-screen madness. Wishlist now!
